units.text: The claim states Apple's fiscal 2025 effective tax rate was 21%, but the source records it as 15.6%, contradicting the assertion.

citations.title: Apple SEC filings: What Apple’s 2025 10-K Reveals

judgement.reason: The passage supports that Apple's fiscal 2025 effective tax rate was recorded as 15.6%, but it does not mention any claim stating it was 21%, so the contradiction cannot be fully verified from the passage alone.
